description: This script is a linter that checks whether Python test files contain a main block that calls run_tests or raises an exception, ensuring tests are run in OSS CI. It uses libcst for parsing and matching code patterns.

classes.name: HasMainVisiter
classes.description: A CSTVisitor that checks if a module contains a main block calling run_tests or run_rank.

classes.name: LintSeverity
classes.description: An enumeration of severity levels for lint messages.

classes.name: LintMessage
classes.description: A data structure representing a lint message with details such as path, code, severity, and description.

methods.name: check_file
methods.description: Reads a file, parses it, and returns lint messages if the main block is missing.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that runs the linter on provided filenames using multiprocessing.
